_about: Wanted shinobi who hold a lair out in the wilds. Each is a jonin-class fight with one of the rival models. 'danger' (0-2) says which regions' wilds they hide in; 'health' is for the first part of the story and grows with EnemyTier. 'model' is a file in assets/characters/rivals.

bounties.name: Goro Kiln-Hand
bounties.taunt: Forty years I fired their roof-tiles. Then the roof fell in on me. Come, let me show you what a kiln can do.

bounties.name: Sayo the Reed Widow
bounties.taunt: The river keeps what it takes. It took my husband's name. It will take yours.

bounties.name: Daigo Millstone
bounties.taunt: Slow, they called me. Slow grinds fine. Stand still and I will show you.

bounties.name: Tsuzumi the Hollow Drum
bounties.taunt: Hear that? Every beat is a bolt I have not thrown yet.

bounties.name: Ruri Ember-Tail
bounties.taunt: They put a price on me, so I put a price on them. Fair trade.

bounties.name: Hayate Gale-Tithe
bounties.taunt: Every wind has a toll. You are standing in mine.

bounties.name: Warden Fuyuki of the Long Frost
bounties.taunt: I kept this road for the Leaf of Winter until the war forgot me. I will not be forgotten twice.

bounties.name: Ikazuchi the Stormwake
bounties.taunt: The sky owes me a hundred storms. Let me collect them on you.

bounties.name: Ishizue the Cairn-Breaker
bounties.taunt: I have broken a hundred cairns. The dead never complain. Will you?

bounties.name: The Nameless Blade
bounties.taunt: I gave my name away to be free of it. Do not ask for it. Draw.
